text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?

Daniel, relax. That wasn’t about you. I was talking about that viral video from this week, the one with the Bundesliga striker. If you think every joke about a missed shot is aimed at you, you’re taking things way too personally.

Oh, okay. I just… I guess I felt a bit weird since everyone at your table laughed and then looked over. Maybe I’m just a bit sensitive after Sunday. Sorry if I jumped to conclusions. If it really wasn’t about me, then that’s good.

No worries, man. I get it, Sunday was rough. Honestly, I didn’t even think about your chance, it was just a stupid video. If it made you feel weird, that wasn’t my intention at all. Next time I’ll try to keep it down with the jokes. Want a drink? My round.

Thanks, Lukas, that’s really nice of you. I appreciate it, honestly. I probably just need to chill a bit. If you’re sure it wasn’t about me, then I’m glad. Uh… yeah, I’ll have whatever you’re having, if that’s okay.

Of course, no problem. I’m having a Helles, so I’ll get you one too. And seriously, don’t worry about it. Everyone’s missed chances before, it’s part of the game. If you want to talk about Sunday, I’m happy to listen. Otherwise, let’s just enjoy the evening.

Thanks, that means a lot. I guess it just stuck with me, you know? But you’re right, it happens to everyone. I don’t want to drag the mood down, so... let’s just have a good evening. And thanks for being so cool about it.

You’re welcome, Daniel. Honestly, I get what you mean, those moments can really stick with you. But no one’s judging you, especially not me. Let’s just kick back and have a good night. If you ever want to talk football, or anything else, I’m around. Cheers, man.
